About Tether

Tether (USDT) is the largest stablecoin by market capitalization, designed to track the US dollar 1:1 and backed by reserves held by Tether. It is issued on many blockchains, including Tron and Ethereum.

Where this USDT price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (USDT-USD) and Kraken (USDT/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 183.25B USDT (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
